item.title: I Put My Entire Life Into a Database: 3.8 Million Rows of Quantified Self Data
item.description: Felix Krause spent three years tracking 380,000 life data points - from mood to weather, exercise to coffee intake - all stored in a Postgres database. This isn't geek OCD; it's a hardcore experiment in self-knowledge.
